product.description: Monoprice™1‑Gang Decora Brush Plate, BlackDiscreet Wiring Management Component for Entertainment or Workspace ApplicationsThe 1‑Gang Decora Brush Plate, Black offers a sleek, professional solution for managing and concealing low‑voltage cables in residential or commercial installations. Designed with both aesthetics and functionality in mind, this brush‑style wall plate provides an attractive, clutter‑free finish while allowing multiple cables to pass through a single opening. Whether you're routing HDMI®, coaxial, speaker, or data cables, this plate delivers a clean, organized, and accessible option that blends seamlessly into modern interiors.Unlike traditional open‑wall cable pass‑throughs, the integrated brush insert allows cables to pass through without leaving unsightly gaps or holes. The tightly packed bristles close neatly around the wires, minimizing dust entry and preventing exposure of wall cavities. This makes it ideal for home theaters, media rooms, conference spaces, or any application where maintaining a polished appearance is as important as functionality.The 1‑Gang Decora Brush Plate mounts directly to a standard low‑voltage mounting bracket, ensuring a simple and efficient installation for both professionals and DIY users. Just secure the bracket, attach the plate, and feed the cables through—the process is quick and requires no special tools. The Decora‑style design matches standard decorator openings, ensuring compatibility with other Decora devices and providing a uniform, coordinated look across wall plates and outlets.Finished in elegant black, this brush plate adds a modern touch that pairs perfectly with darker walls, home theater equipment, or office environments where a clean, minimalist appearance is preferred. It not only conceals cable entry points but also enhances the overall presentation of your entertainment or professional space.Durable, reliable, and designed for long‑term performance, the Decora Brush Plate is built to meet the demands of today's high‑tech homes and offices. It's the perfect finishing accessory for installers, AV professionals, and tech‑savvy homeowners who value both form and function in their cable management solutions.With its combination of easy installation, premium design, and effective cable concealment, the 1‑Gang Decora Brush Plate, Black is a must‑have for anyone seeking a neat, professional‑grade setup.
